categories.name: Handles

categories.name: Knobs

categories.name: Hinges

products.name: Luxury Black & Gold Geometric Cabinet Pull Handle
products.description: Contemporary dual-tone cabinet pull handle with lustrous gold accents and matte black inlay. Built for luxury wardrobes and bespoke modern kitchen cabinetry.

products.name: Matte Black & Gold Banded T-Bar Cabinet Handle
products.description: Refined cylindrical T-bar handle featuring gold ring accents on a rich matte black bar. Available in multiple lengths and matching single knobs.

specs.label: Finish
specs.value: Matte Black with Polished Gold Rings

products.name: Matte Black Modern Bow Bridge Cabinet Handle
products.description: Ergonomic bridge-style arched cabinet handle with flared mounting feet. Clean minimalist design suitable for contemporary kitchens and furniture.

products.name: Brushed Stainless Steel Heavy-Duty Modern Bar Handle
products.description: Corrosion-resistant brushed stainless steel round bar pull handles with solid square standoffs. High durability for heavy traffic cabinets.

products.name: Minimalist Aluminum Edge Profile Pull Handle
products.description: Modern edge-mounted profile pull handle available in Brushed Gold and Matte Black. Mounts seamlessly on the top or side edge of doors for a sleek handleless look.

products.name: Matte Black Architectural T-Bar Cabinet Pull & Knob
products.description: Bold square-profile matte black T-bar handle with solid square posts. Engineered for heavy kitchen pantry doors and vanity drawers.

products.name: Matte Black Concealed Lip Edge Finger Pull Handle
products.description: Low-profile continuous lip finger pull that slots neatly over cabinet door edges. Provides a clean seamless aesthetic without visible screw heads.

products.name: Modern Oval Paperclip Drop Ring Drawer Knob
products.description: Creative dual-tone designer oval ring knob with gold frame and vibrant matte insert plates (Black, White, Orange, Silver). Perfect accent for luxury dressers.

products.name: Solid Polished Spherical Ball Cabinet Knob
products.description: Heavy solid spherical ball knob with mirror-polished reflective finish. Available in French Gold, Rose Gold, and Mirror Chrome.

products.name: Magic Corner Kitchen Pull-Out Blind Corner Organizer Basket
products.description: Heavy-duty 2-tier magic corner mechanism with smooth soft-close sliding tracks. Pulls blind corner kitchen contents forward for effortless access.

products.name: Multi-Tier Kitchen Tall Larder / Tandem Pantry Pull-Out Unit
products.description: Tall pantry larder storage system with dual-action door trays and internal pull-out shelves. Maximizes vertical kitchen storage space.

products.name: Premium Glass-Side Tall Pantry Pull-Out Larder Unit
products.description: High-end tall larder unit with transparent smoked glass side guards and non-slip mats. Full extension soft close slide mechanism.

products.name: Soft-Close Tall Larder Swing-Out Pantry Unit
products.description: Swing-out 180° revolving tall pantry system. When opened, inner baskets glide forward while door baskets pivot outward for full panoramic visibility.

products.name: Heavy-Duty Pull-Down Elevator Upper Cabinet Spice Rack
products.description: Hydraulic counterbalanced pull-down storage basket for overhead wall cabinets. Lowers jars and spices directly into comfortable reaching height.

products.name: Kitchen Under-Counter Dish & Plate Organizer Drawer Rack
products.description: Pull-out base cabinet drawer basket designed with dedicated vertical slots for dinner plates, bowls, and cookware with drip drainage base.

products.name: Heavy-Duty 90° Corner Cabinet Suspension Hanging Bracket Fittings
products.description: Concealed steel corner brackets with snap-on decorative cover caps. Used for structural assembly and wall hanging of heavy kitchen and wardrobe cabinets.

specs.label: Material
specs.value: Zinc Plated Steel with ABS Cover

products.name: Luxury Wardrobe Leather Jewelry & Watch Organizer Drawer Tray
products.description: Master closet organizer tray wrapped in premium grey micro-suede leather with custom compartments for watches, rings, sunglasses, and precious jewelry.

products.name: Wardrobe Pull-Out Woven Rattan Laundry & Storage Basket
products.description: Breathable hand-woven rattan storage basket set into an aluminum pullout frame with concealed soft-close slide runners.

products.name: Kitchen Cutlery & Utensil Organizer Grey ABS Drawer Tray
products.description: Durable food-grade ABS cutlery organizer tray with molded compartments for spoons, knives, forks, and long cooking utensils.

products.name: HIPPONT 90cm Slim Flat Kitchen Heat Extractor
products.description: High suction 90cm flat kitchen heat extractor hood with digital touch control panel, multi-layer aluminum grease filters, and ultra-bright LED work lighting.

products.name: HIPPONT 5-Burner Tempered Glass Built-In Cooktop Hob
products.description: Premium 5-burner gas cooktop with 8mm explosion-proof tempered black glass, heavy-duty cast iron pan supports, and automatic electric pulse ignition.

products.name: POLYSTAR 20L Built-In Microwave with Frame Kit (PV-BD20BBL)
products.description: Polystar 20-Litre built-in microwave oven with integrated grill function, seamless trim frame kit, 700W microwave output, and 900W grill power input.

products.name: POLYSTAR 4-Burner & 1 Electric Built-In Gas Hob (PV-JYPS4G1EB)
products.description: Dual-fuel hybrid built-in hob featuring 4 rapid gas burners and 1 rapid electric hotplate on an 8mm black stainless steel chassis with metal control knobs.

specs.label: Knobs
specs.value: Heat-resistant Metal Knobs with BS Plug

products.name: POLYSTAR 90cm Digital Rangehood with Voice Control (PV-TD9110BVC)
products.description: Smart kitchen rangehood with intelligent voice commands, infrared hand gesture control, pure copper motor, metal blower, and aluminum charcoal filters.

specs.label: Filter
specs.value: Aluminum Charcoal Filter with Metal Blower
